name: CUET General Test Practice Mock - Practice Test 2

questions.question: In CUET, what does CUET stand for?
questions.hint: CUET is a standardized admission exam administered by the NTA.

questions.question: Who is the current Chairman of UGC?
questions.hint: Prof. M. Jagadesh Kumar is the head of University Grants Commission.

questions.question: What is the capital of Uttarakhand?
questions.hint: Dehradun is the winter capital of Uttarakhand.

questions.question: The G20 Summit in 2023 was hosted by which country?
questions.hint: India hosted the 18th G20 summit at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi.

questions.question: Find the next term in series: Z, W, T, Q, ?
questions.hint: Subtract 3 letters each step: Z(26) -> W(23) -> T(20) -> Q(17) -> N(14).
